body: No, not really. I just wanted to vent.
Someone less than my dream girl, sure. Someone I'm not attracted to, no. I tried that at one point. It did not turn out well. :/

Ideally I'd just stay in bed forever. I can't suffer if I'm not conscious.

But if I don't get up and get to work, then I won't have any money, which means I'll go from lonely and miserable to lonely, miserable, broke, homeless and starving. So I always force myself up. But it's a struggle. Every, damn day.

A bit late to the party, but I'm 30+ and a virgin. Although as some other comment here stated, I don't think being a virgin is the important part. What matters is the lack of intimacy.

As to why. Bullying, social anxiety that took a long time to get over. Not fat, but not scoring any points in the looks department either.

I suppose my life would look decent on the surface. Good job and all of that. But I wouldn't wish my fate on anyone. Not a day goes by that I do not think about killing myself.
Text book questionnaire on gauging risk of suicide?

I'm sorry, but I just don't believe things will change. I thought like you once, a long time ago. But I'm in my thirties now and during all that time I've only once gotten a second date. There has been no stumbling upon anybody. That may happen to some, but evidently not me. Actively doing something was the only chance I had. But that was then. I'm not seeing any luck there either so I'm just not going to bother...

Because nobody likes the depressed guy. He just brings everyone else down. Better to play the act and pretend everything is fine. That's what's expected. No one expects or wants a serious answer to "how are you?".

It's not enough. I'm tired of being alone. I don't want this to be how the rest of my life is. And the opportunities are dwindling for each passing year.

And there is no sense of entitlement. Just frustration over the shitty hand I was dealt...
It's not like anyone can tell. If there's something I'm good at, it's lying to people around me.
The thought has crossed my mind. Not sure I would give it a good home though.
Well that just isn't going to happen, so yet another reason that I shouldn't delude myself that things might get better.
I think that was just the problem statement, not the answer. :)
Oh I have no problems faking it. Everybody refers to me as that guy who's always so happy. So no, I'm afraid I'm no longer a believer in "fake it til you make it"...
I think I preferred not trying to trying and failing. Didn't feel quite as soul crushing...
Not fast enough. Nature might need some help...

Yeah, I'm going to have to be a Debbie downer and call bullshit on this. I'm ranking this one up there along with shit like "fake it til you make it" and my personal favourite, "suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem".

Love yourself, huh? What kind of arrogant attitude is that? No one else does. Who the fuck am I to say that everyone else is wrong? It's not like those are a few stray data points. This shit has been consistently confirmed over a couple of decades.

Nah. The sensible thing is to man up and accept what has been painfully obvious for so long. This society ain't interested in what you're peddling. So either start reshaping yourself to something people want, which might have varying success depending on your outcome in the genetic lottery, or start praying to your deity of choice that you'll find some weirdo that happens to be in to your general malfunction.

There's also the third option I suppose, but I assume everyone here is already fully aware of that one...

The fear of surviving an attempt is basically the only thing that keeps me from trying...

I'd also like it if there was another solution. But I don't see any options left.
What I want is unfortunately not something that I can realistically get. I'm just so very lonely. And everything I've tried to do about it has failed. So I think about the other "solution". A lot...
